de.abas.erp.db.selection

Class ExpertSelection<T extends SelectableRecord>

  • Object
    • ExpertSelection<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - Selected type

    public final class ExpertSelection<T extends SelectableRecord>
extends Object
    Factory class for various selections. This class is for expert use only. Criteria will be passed to the ERP database directly. Because the default settings vary at some points, you need to specify your desired field name language with @language=en or @language=de.
